notes.title: Biologger Live Stream and AMA
notes.content:
Biologger is a hard as nails precision platformer. Make your way through unique worlds each with a different and exciting twist. On your journey scan and research creatures to complete your logs. Biologger was developed with speedrunning in mind - how fast can you beat the game?

Join the developers as we play the game and ask us anything! Want to join the stream and talk to us as we play? Join [url=discord.gg/x3uVzpm]THE DISCORD[/url] during the stream!
